scope: All modified tracked and non-ignored untracked files at start; no staging, git mutations, network or deployment by this audit.

limitations: Matching values are deliberately omitted; only path, line, type and classification are reported.
No .env or credentials files are opened. Binary images/PDFs are not OCR scanned.
This is a finite regex scan, not universal proof that no secret exists.

git_ignore_check.command: git check-ignore -v --no-index .env.local .env.production .vercel/project.json .next/cache/probe data/private/probe uploads/probe reports/private/probe test-results/probe playwright-report/probe

vercel_excludes.limitation: Vercel CLI upload exclusions do not exclude already committed files from GitHub or guarantee behavior of Git integration checkout.

public_routes_review.public_demo_gate: readAiConfig returns PUBLIC_DEMO before reading API key; POST returns 403 before reading body or constructing provider

evidence_provenance.engineering_sources: Modified product/docs/tests and 139-file source inventory are engineering material; no new data ingress route.
evidence_provenance.workspace_backups: Four actual v3 backups independently match golden manifest and CSV bytes.
evidence_provenance.other_artifacts: Acceptance and browser/E2E metadata identify golden/demo/errors/tests/fixtures/alternative or synthetic edge cases; 26 download hashes still match the original inventory. Screenshots/PDFs are retained engineering evidence from those runs.
evidence_provenance.review_package: Nine originals hash-match attached ZIP. README/evidence_receipt explicitly identify public deployed resources and small synthetic fixture; reviewer did not complete browser E2E.
evidence_provenance.manual_browser_download_limit: CUA manual download did not yield bytes; Playwright downloads supply verified bytes. This audit does not relabel manual downloads as passed.

limitations: Read-only package audit: no stage, commit, push, deployment, environment secret read or attachment script execution.
166 UTF-8 candidates were scanned with finite rules; 112 image/PDF binary artifacts were classified by known test/manual provenance, not full OCR or independent pixel re-review.
Candidate list is time-bound and excludes this audit pair created afterwards; any concurrently added release evidence must be reviewed before staging.
Original acceptance records are historical and still correctly say that release was not run then. This new release audit does not rewrite them.
Remote GitHub visibility, Vercel configuration, deployment identity and post-release live endpoint checks belong to the authorized main release flow.
Live AI remains not_run; mock/gate evidence is not live-provider acceptance.
